US$300, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$300, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

bottomLine: Settlex AI does what it says mechanically - signals, two modes, a broker partner. The open questions are pricing clarity and verification, both solvable by reading before funding.
The final score lands at 4.5 - a capable platform held back by its own paperwork. Start small, verify the claims yourself and never trade money you cannot lose.
